<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Sudeendra K — 3D Resume</title>
<meta name="description" content="Interactive 3D resume of Sudeendra K — EEE (VLSI Design & Technology) undergraduate focused on RTL design, embedded systems and AI hardware.">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#070b14; --panel:rgba(14,22,38,.72); --line:rgba(0,247,255,.22);
    --accent:#00f7ff; --accent2:#7c5cff; --text:#e6edf7; --muted:#93a4bd;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
  #bg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
  nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:10;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 5vw;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg),transparent)}
  nav .brand{font-family:"Fira Code",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px}
  nav ul{display:flex;gap:22px;list-style:none}
  nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;transition:color .2s}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
  main{position:relative;z-index:5}
  section{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:90px 5vw}
  .wrap{max-width:1000px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
  .hero{align-items:flex-start}
  .hero .wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;pointer-events:none}
  .hero a,.hero .btn{pointer-events:auto}
  .tag{font-family:"Fira Code",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--accent);font-size:14px}
  h1{font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,76px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-1px}
  h1 span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
  .sub{max-width:560px;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px}
  .btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
  .btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--accent)}
  .btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#041018;border:none;font-weight:600}
  h2{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:6px}
  h2::before{content:"// ";color:var(--accent);font-family:"Fira Code",ui-monospace,monospace}
  .lead{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:26px}
  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
  .card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;transform-style:preserve-3d}
  .card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,247,255,.12)}
  .card h3{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .meta{font-family:"Fira Code",ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
  .card p,.card li{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
  .card ul{padding-left:18px;margin-top:6px}
  .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
  .chip{font-size:12px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);background:rgba(0,247,255,.06)}
  .timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;border-left:2px solid var(--line);padding-left:22px}
  .timeline .card{position:relative}
  .timeline .card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-30px;top:26px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--accent)}
  .contact a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}
  footer{position:relative;z-index:5;text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
  .hint{position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:10;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-family:"Fira Code",ui-monospace,monospace;opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
  @media (max-width:720px){nav ul{display:none} section{padding:80px 6vw}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>

<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": { "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js" } }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const canvas = document.getElementById('bg');
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const CYAN = 0x00f7ff, VIOLET = 0x7c5cff;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x070b14, 0.045);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, innerWidth / innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, 2.2, 8);

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x6688aa, 0.8));
const key = new THREE.PointLight(CYAN, 30, 30); key.position.set(4, 5, 4); scene.add(key);
const rim = new THREE.PointLight(VIOLET, 25, 30); rim.position.set(-5, 2, -3); scene.add(rim);

/* ---------- Chip (silicon die) ---------- */
const chip = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(chip);

const pkg = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.2, 0.3, 3.2),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0c1424, metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.35 })
);
chip.add(pkg);
const pkgEdges = new THREE.LineSegments(
  new THREE.EdgesGeometry(pkg.geometry),
  new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: CYAN, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8 })
);
chip.add(pkgEdges);

const die = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.9, 0.12, 1.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x14203a, emissive: 0x0a2a44, metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.2 })
);
die.position.y = 0.21;
chip.add(die);

// pins
const pinMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xc9d6e8, metalness: 1, roughness: 0.3 });
const pinGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, 0.06, 0.34);
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  const t = -1.35 + i * 0.3;
  [[t, 1.75, 0], [t, -1.75, 0], [1.75, t, Math.PI / 2], [-1.75, t, Math.PI / 2]].forEach(([a, b, rot]) => {
    const p = new THREE.Mesh(pinGeo, pinMat);
    if (rot === 0) p.position.set(a, -0.05, b);
    else { p.position.set(a, -0.05, b); p.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; }
    chip.add(p);
  });
}

// glowing traces on the die
const traceMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: CYAN, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 });
for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
  const z = -0.8 + i * 0.2;
  const pts = [new THREE.Vector3(-0.9, 0.28, z), new THREE.Vector3(-0.3 + (i % 3) * 0.2, 0.28, z), new THREE.Vector3(0.1 + (i % 4) * 0.15, 0.28, z + 0.1), new THREE.Vector3(0.9, 0.28, z + 0.1)];
  chip.add(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), traceMat));
}

/* ---------- Avatar frame floating above chip ---------- */
const avatarGroup = new THREE.Group();
avatarGroup.position.set(0, 2.3, 0);
chip.add(avatarGroup);

const avatarMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
function fallbackTexture() {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 512;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 512, 512);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#0b1426'); grad.addColorStop(1, '#1b2a4d');
  g.fillStyle = grad; g.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
  g.fillStyle = '#00f7ff'; g.font = '700 220px monospace'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
  g.fillText('SK', 256, 270);
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}
avatarMat.map = fallbackTexture();
new THREE.TextureLoader().load('data:image/jpeg;base64,',
  tex => { tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; avatarMat.map = tex; avatarMat.needsUpdate = true; },
  undefined,
  () => { /* keep SK fallback if the image is missing */ }
);
const avatar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.9, 1.9), avatarMat);
avatarGroup.add(avatar);
const frame = new THREE.LineSegments(
  new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.0, 2.0, 0.04)),
  new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: CYAN })
);
avatarGroup.add(frame);

/* ---------- Floor grid ---------- */
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(60, 60, CYAN, 0x16314d);
grid.position.y = -1.4;
grid.material.transparent = true; grid.material.opacity = 0.35;
scene.add(grid);

/* ---------- Particles ---------- */
const N = 900, pos = new Float32Array(N * 3);
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  pos[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
  pos[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 18 - 3;
  pos[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
}
const pGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
pGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
const particles = new THREE.Points(pGeo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: CYAN, size: 0.05, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 }));
scene.add(particles);

/* ---------- Interaction ---------- */
let mx = 0, my = 0, scrollP = 0;
addEventListener('pointermove', e => { mx = (e.clientX / innerWidth - 0.5) * 2; my = (e.clientY / innerHeight - 0.5) * 2; });
function updateScroll() {
  const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
  scrollP = max > 0 ? scrollY / max : 0;
}
addEventListener('scroll', updateScroll, { passive: true });
updateScroll();

function layout() {
  renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
  camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
addEventListener('resize', layout);

// card tilt (CSS 3D)
document.querySelectorAll('.tilt').forEach(el => {
  el.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5, y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
    el.style.transform = `perspective(700px) rotateX(${(-y * 8).toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${(x * 8).toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-3px)`;
  });
  el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { el.style.transform = ''; });
});

/* ---------- Loop ---------- */
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
const target = new THREE.Vector3();
function frame_() {
  const t = clock.getElapsedTime();
  const wide = innerWidth > 820;

  if (!reduceMotion) {
    chip.rotation.y = t * 0.25 + scrollP * Math.PI * 2;
    chip.position.y = Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.12;
    avatarGroup.position.y = 2.3 + Math.sin(t * 1.2) * 0.08;
    avatarGroup.rotation.y = -chip.rotation.y + mx * 0.35; // keeps the portrait facing the viewer
    particles.rotation.y = t * 0.012;
  } else {
    avatarGroup.rotation.y = -chip.rotation.y;
  }

  // chip sits to the right on desktop and fades back as you scroll
  const targetX = wide ? 2.6 - scrollP * 1.2 : 0;
  chip.position.x += (targetX - chip.position.x) * 0.06;
  const s = wide ? 1 - scrollP * 0.25 : 0.7;
  chip.scale.setScalar(s);

  target.set(mx * 0.6, 2.2 - my * 0.4 + scrollP * 1.5, 8 - scrollP * 1.5);
  camera.position.lerp(target, 0.05);
  camera.lookAt(chip.position.x * 0.6, 1.0, 0);

  traceMat.opacity = 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.25;
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame_);
}
frame_();
</script>
</body>
</html>
